name: Openfort
description: Wallet infrastructure for agents: policy-bounded backend wallets an agent controls, paying via x402 or MPP, with a CLI that runs as an MCP server to create wallets, set policies and send transactions.

skills.name: Hold Funds in Agent Wallet
skills.description: Creates a backend EVM wallet that an autonomous agent controls, persisted as the agent's onchain identity.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Bounds an agent wallet with signing policies that limit which contracts, methods and amounts it may sign.

skills.name: Pay with x402
skills.description: Lets an agent pay HTTP services from its Openfort wallet with x402 or the Machine Payments Protocol on Tempo.

skills.name: Manage Wallets from MCP
skills.description: Exposes every Openfort CLI command as an MCP tool, so an agent can create wallets, manage policies and send transactions.
